title: Song studio
summary: The engine room for songs: choose which declared engine renders, start a render, watch it, stop it - one at a time, and nothing claimed that was not written.

surfaces.web: N/A(by steward decision 2026-09-25 - web parity is decided in WO-0002)

notes: The actuator half of the song pair: `lygo.musicinfo` reads the facts, `lygo.musicwatch` finds the faults, and this module is where a song is actually started, watched and stopped from the console. It owns exactly one thing - `save/music`, the operator's engine choice and one record per render - written through atomicio behind the p0 gate. It renders nothing itself: every render goes through the `music_generate` limb, which is declared here as owned (the limb itself lives in limbs.py and is not re-registered, so no tool changes behaviour and none is listed twice). A job record says what really happened: the song path the limb wrote, or the limb's own named failure. The audio bytes are served by the kernel's media route (/api/media/audio/<name>), the same way chat pictures are, so the panel plays a song that is already on disk and a page reload can never start a render.
